items.question: List up to 10 airlines that use US dollars, showing their names and airline codes, ordered alphabetically by name and then by airline code.
items.reference_sql: SELECT c~name, c~carrier_id FROM /DMO/CARRIER AS c WHERE c~currency_code = 'USD' ORDER BY c~name ASCENDING, c~carrier_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

items.question: List up to 10 airports in London, showing their names and airport codes, ordered alphabetically by name and then by airport code.
items.reference_sql: SELECT a~name, a~airport_id FROM /DMO/AIRPORT AS a WHERE a~city = 'London' ORDER BY a~name ASCENDING, a~airport_id ASCENDING UP TO 10 ROWS

items.question: How many customers have an address in Germany?
items.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM /DMO/CUSTOMER AS c WHERE c~country_code = 'DE'
